Title: One Fine Day

Cast

1. Kunal - 9 years, son
Look: red T-shirt, jeans
2. Naira - 13 years, daughter
Look: green salwar-kurta, short hair
3. Sonali - 38 years, mother
Look: green saree

Places

1. The living room - a sofa, a table, a big window
2. The courtyard - a brick floor, a tulsi plant
3. The park - green grass, swings, benches

Scene 1: The living room - Day

[Kunal stands in the living room. Sonali stands near him.]

Sonali: "Today feels like a good day."

[Kunal combs his hair in front of the mirror.]

Sonali: "I knew it!"

[Kunal puts on his shoes and ties the laces.]

Kunal: "How beautiful!"

[Kunal serves hot rotis to Mother.]

Kunal: "Okay, Mom."

[Kunal studies for his exam.]

Kunal (excited): "What happened?"

[Kunal lies down on the sofa.]

Kunal: "What happened?"

[Kunal knocks on the door.]

Sonali (softly): "I'm ready!"

[Kunal opens the door and goes out.]

Kunal: "What next?"

Scene 2: The courtyard - Day

[Kunal stands in the courtyard. Sonali stands near him.]

Sonali: "So, here we are!"

[Kunal walks across the courtyard.]

Kunal: "This is amazing!"

[Kunal stamps his foot in anger.]

Sonali (softly): "Kunal, listen!"

[Night falls and the stars come out.]

Kunal: "Really?"

[Kunal trips over a stone and falls.]

Sonali: "What next?"

Scene 3: The park - Day

Kunal: "What a nice place."

[Kunal does push-ups.]

Kunal: "That was fun!"

[Kunal does yoga on a mat.]

Sonali: "Yes, all right."

[Naira skips rope.]

Sonali: "Hey, look at that!"

Scene 4: The courtyard - Night

[Kunal stands in the courtyard. Sonali stands near him.]

Sonali: "Let's begin."

[A full moon shines in the sky.]

Sonali: "Well done!"

[Fireflies glow in the dark.]

Sonali: "That was such a fun day!"
